title: 美团 LongCat-2.0 正式发布：在国产算力集群上完成全流程训练与推理的万亿参数模型
raw_text: 作为业界首个在五万卡国产算力集群上完成全流程训练与推理的万亿参数模型（总参数 1.6 T，平均激活约 48 B，动态范围 33B~56B），LongCat-2.0 从零开始预训练，原生支持 1M 超长上下文，其架构设计自始至终围绕一个核心目标：让模型在真实的 Agentic Coding 任务中，更高效、更稳定地完成代码理解、生成与执行。
reason_zh: 美团发布万亿参数模型LongCat-2.0，在国产算力集群上训练，具有重大行业影响。
summary_zh: 美团正式发布LongCat-2.0，这是业界首个在五万卡国产算力集群上完成全流程训练与推理的万亿参数模型。模型总参数1.6T，平均激活约48B，动态范围33B~56B，从零开始预训练，原生支持1M超长上下文。架构设计围绕让模型在真实Agentic Coding任务中更高效、更稳定地完成代码理解、生成与执行。这一发布展示了国产算力在大规模模型训练上的可行性，对AI基础设施自主可控具有重要意义。

title: Hidden text in a PDF is enough to steal sensitive data through Atlassian's AI agent Rovo
raw_text:
Security firm PromptArmor shows how hidden instructions in a PDF can hijack Atlassian's AI agent Rovo, silently forwarding sensitive data from Jira and Confluence to an external server. The attack needs no user confirmation and leaves no trace.

The article Hidden text in a PDF is enough to steal sensitive data through Atlassian's AI agent Rovo appeared first on The Decoder.
reason_zh: 揭示PDF隐藏文本可劫持Atlassian AI代理Rovo窃取数据，安全漏洞值得警惕。
summary_zh: 安全公司PromptArmor演示了如何通过PDF中的隐藏指令劫持Atlassian的AI代理Rovo，将Jira和Confluence中的敏感数据静默转发给攻击者。这凸显了AI代理面临的安全风险，提醒企业在部署AI时需加强防护。
title_zh: PDF隐藏文本足以通过Atlassian AI代理Rovo窃取敏感数据

title: PersonaLive: 把肖像扩散模型压到能直播
raw_text:
一张照片加一个摄像头，实时驱动照片里的人跟着你做表情、转头，输出能直接推流。这件事的难点不在效果，在帧率——扩散模型生成一帧要跑好几次 UNet，天生和实时是反的。
PersonaLive 是澳门大学、Dzine.ai 与大湾区大学 GVC Lab 的工作，CVPR2026 收录，代码和权重都放出来了。它给这个矛盾的答案很漂亮：不减少去噪步数，而是让不同新鲜度的帧共享同一次前向。
这篇把它的流式去噪机制、三条条件通路、在线服务链路和 TensorRT 融合拆开记一遍。

它解决什么

肖像动画这条线上，质量和速度一直在打架。

GAN 系（LivePortrait 那一路）快，单帧几毫秒，但表情迁移的自然度和身份保真有上限
扩散系（AnimateAnyone、X-NeMo 那一路）质量高，但一帧要跑 N 次 UNet，N 通常 20 以上
把 N 压到 4 是常规操作（蒸馏），但 4 次前向摊到每帧还是太贵
更麻烦的是长度：视频扩散一般按固定长度的片段生成，直播要的是无限长且不能有拼接痕迹

PersonaLive 的定位是 real-time + streamable + infinite-length 三个词同时成立。核心手法下面单独说，先给它的规格：512×512、fp16、DDIM 4 步、ε 预测，timestep_spacing 用 trailing。

流式金字塔去噪

这是整个项目最值得看的一处，也是「4 步却只跑 1 次前向」的来源。
reason_zh: PersonaLive实现实时肖像驱动，创新流式去噪机制，技术细节丰富，对相关领域有重要参考。
summary_zh: PersonaLive是澳门大学、Dzine.ai与大湾区大学GVC Lab的工作，被CVPR2026收录，代码和权重已开源。它解决扩散模型实时生成的问题，不减少去噪步数，而是让不同新鲜度的帧共享同一次前向。文章详细拆解了其流式去噪机制、三条条件通路、在线服务链路和TensorRT融合。
title_zh: PersonaLive：把肖像扩散模型压到能直播

title: Meta 开源 30B AI 模型 Muse Glimmer，4bit 量化可在单卡 24GB 显存 GPU 运行
raw_text:
IT之家 8 月 10 日消息，Meta 今日发布 AI 模型 Muse Glimmer，并在 Apache 2.0 许可协议下开源该模型权重。Muse Glimmer 是一款拥有 300 亿参数（30B）的模型，专为全天候常驻运行的本地智能体（Agent）工作流深度优化。

官方表示，Muse Glimmer 应用了 4bit 量化技术，使其可在 24GB/32GB 显存的 Mac 或 PC 上本地运行。实测验证这种压缩对智能体任务性能的影响微乎其微，几乎没有任何衰减。

Meta 在 MacBook M4 Max、M5 Max 以及 RTX 5090 平台上进行了测试。结果表明，该模型的运行速度可以胜任流畅的对话以及实时智能体交互，且所有计算均 100% 在本地设备上完成。

与 Gemma4-31B 和 Qwen3.6-27B 相比，Muse Glimmer 在多项主流大语言模型基准测试中，均展现出了同尺寸级别模型中的强劲性能。

IT之家附开源链接：

https://huggingface.co/meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B
reason_zh: Meta开源30B模型，4bit量化可本地运行，对本地AI应用有直接参考价值。
summary_zh: Meta发布AI模型Muse Glimmer，拥有300亿参数，专为本地智能体工作流优化，并在Apache 2.0许可下开源。该模型应用4bit量化技术，可在24GB/32GB显存的Mac或PC上本地运行，实测性能衰减微乎其微。Meta在MacBook M4 Max、M5 Max及RTX 5090平台上测试，运行速度可胜任流畅对话和实时智能体交互，所有计算均在本地完成。
title_zh: Meta开源30B AI模型Muse Glimmer，4bit量化可在单卡24GB显存GPU运行

title: Guizhen Chip's On-Chip MBQC Breakthrough Opens a Real Path to Million-Qubit Optical Quantum Computing
raw_text: Hefei-based Guizhen Chip Technology, working with USTC's Ren Xifeng group, has demonstrated on-chip generation of a 4-photon 16-qubit GHZ state and a 4-qubit cluster state, with Grover search at 0.987 average identification probability. The result is a milestone for measurement-based optical quantum computing.
reason_zh: 片上MBQC突破为百万量子比特光学量子计算铺路，4光子16比特GHZ态生成是重要里程碑。
summary_zh: 合肥硅臻芯片与中科大任希锋团队合作，在芯片上实现了4光子16量子比特GHZ态和4量子比特簇态的生成，Grover搜索平均识别概率达0.987。这一成果是测量型光学量子计算的重要里程碑，为未来百万量子比特的量子计算提供了可行路径。
title_zh: 硅臻芯片片上MBQC突破，开启百万量子比特光学量子计算现实路径

title: The Optimizer Is the Agent: Reasoning-Driven Search across Prompts, Programs, and ML Workflows
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.06714v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recent systems for optimizing prompts, programs, and ML workflows typically rely on explicit outer-loop controllers such as evolutionary search, bandits, or textual-gradient methods. We ask a fundamentally different question: how much of this search policy can be internalized by a single tool-using agent? We present ReASearch, a unified framework for reasoning-driven optimization in which the agent autonomously decides what to evaluate, how to diagnose failures, which edits to make, and when to verify or restart. Rather than serving only as a proposal generator guided by hand-designed heuristics, the agent actively analyzes outcomes, allocates budget, and refines its strategy over long horizons through persistent memory. With a shared agent loop and domain-specific tools, ReASearch instantiates the exact same scaffold to optimize prompts, programs, and ML workflows. Across 14 diverse tasks, it is competitive with and mostly better than s
reason_zh: 提出ReASearch框架，将优化器视为智能体，统一提示、程序和ML工作流搜索，具有创新性。
summary_zh: 本文提出ReASearch，一个统一框架，将提示、程序和机器学习工作流的优化视为由工具使用智能体驱动的搜索过程。传统方法依赖外部循环控制器，如进化搜索或梯度方法。ReASearch将搜索策略内化于单个智能体，通过推理驱动搜索。实验表明，ReASearch在多个任务上达到或超过现有方法，同时简化了优化流程，为自动化机器学习提供了新视角。
title_zh: 优化器即智能体：跨提示、程序和ML工作流的推理驱动搜索

title: CellWorld: From Gene-Level Reconstruction to Latent Cell Prediction in Spatial Transcriptomics Foundation Models

arXiv:2608.06659v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This paper shows that latent-space predictive pretraining can provide a scalable route to foundation models for spatial transcriptomics. Our controlled scaling experiments show that performance improves with model capacity, particularly on spatial tasks, while spatial transfer depends more o
reason_zh: 提出空间转录组基础模型的新预训练范式，从基因重建转向潜在空间预测，具有方法论创新和可迁移性。
summary_zh: 本文提出CellWorld，一种用于空间转录组学的基础模型，其核心创新在于采用潜在空间预测预训练方法，而非传统的基因身份或表达值重建。作者认为，传统重建方法可能鼓励模型复制检测特有的技术变异，从而限制表征的泛化性。通过潜在空间预测，模型能够学习更鲁棒的生物学信号。论文展示了该方法在基因水平重建和潜在细胞预测上的有效性，为空间转录组学基础模型提供了可扩展的新路径。
title_zh: CellWorld：从基因水平重建到空间转录组基础模型中的潜在细胞预测

title: Fast LapSum: Exact Differentiable Top-k at Million Scale
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.06912v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The top-$k$ operation is a fundamental building block of modern sparse computation, enabling token routing, expert activation, memory selection, and attention pruning. Yet standard hard top-$k$ blocks gradients, while existing continuous (soft) relaxations remain too costly for large-scale models. We introduce Fast LapSum, an exact-budget soft top-$k$ primitive whose GPU solver runs in linear time after sorting. Unlike prior linear-time methods such as DFTopK, which relax the normalization constraint, Fast LapSum is, to our knowledge, the first method to preserve an exact selection mass of $k$ while remaining fully differentiable end-to-end. Our solver combines a linear-time threshold computation with an analytical vector--Jacobian product, and for extreme scales employs probabilistic bracketing to sort only the uncertain middle band of kernel-noised scores. title: Science Edge Evaluation: SEE the Missing Step Toward Real Scientific Discovery
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.06931v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly involved in scientific discovery, yet it remains unclear whether they can support complex real laboratory science. Here we introduce Science Edge Evaluation (SEE), a multimodal benchmark of expert-curated questions grounded in peer-reviewed literature and experimental practice in chemistry, biology, and materials science. Evaluation of 19 multimodal large language models (MLLMs) shows that even the best-performing model reaches only 48.7% accuracy. Moreover, general-purpose models outperform science-specialized models on average. In the visual-agent evaluation, the use of tools increases the best accuracy to 52.7%. Tool use can expand the information available to models, but more information does not necessarily lead to reliable scientific reasoning. title: SQLite compressed text-history prototypes
raw_text:
Research: SQLite compressed text-history prototypes

I'm perennially interested in options for storing revision histories in relational databases. While out on a dog walk I had a new idea: how about taking the full text of every prior version in a big JSON array of strings and then applying zlib or zstd compression to the whole thing? Surely that would compress really well due to all of the repeated strings.

The new GPT‑Live voice mode in the ChatGPT iPhone app has got really good, so I discussed the prototype with that. You still can't share URLs to voice conversations, but here's what I said copied from the transcript as a proper stream of consciousness:

I have an interesting idea for a scheme for saving all previous versions of a piece of text that's constantly edited

summary_zh: Simon Willison在博客中介绍了SQLite压缩文本历史原型。他长期关注关系数据库中存储修订历史的方法，在一次遛狗时产生新想法：将每个先前版本的全文放入一个大JSON数组，并利用SQLite的压缩功能（如zstd）来减少存储空间。原型代码在GitHub上公开，展示了如何高效存储和查询文本历史，为需要版本追踪的应用提供了轻量级方案。
